content.short: Revived after rug, community driven project with many uses and services.
content.description:
We’re a 25+ member community led project by the community for the community. After surviving one of the first and most infamous rugpulls in CNFT history, core members took over and rebaked the Gingerbread Squad. Now we are an organically grown decentralized organization with many ongoing ventures.

We currently are beta tasting a trading card game, airdropping and minting a holiday themed NFT collection called Holidazed, we're sending an NFT to space for 30 days and giving it away in a raffle, constantly helping other communities organize to take over their projects and also offer minting services to other CNFT projects. All from a decentralized constantly growing team.
